verdict.rationale: Kushki is an API-first payments platform. It publicly documents API flows for card charges, including direct charge without a token, authorization and capture, refunds and voids, a 100% API 3DS integration, recurring and scheduled charges, plus test data and a move to production. Its docs are also exposed to agents through a live llms.txt index and .md pages, though the old /cl/en doc tree now returns 404 after a move to /cl/*. missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, and docs depth beyond page titles.
